entities.summary: Bishop Mariusz Tomasz Dmyterko is a Polish Ukrainian Greek Catholic hierarch, who is serving as a Titular Bishop of Tzernicus and an Auxiliary Bishop of Eparchy of Wrocław–Koszalin since 10 July 2025.
